This is a senior-to-staff level CRDT Software Engineer role (5–10+ years of experience) at webAI, working on the synchronization and networking layer of a private, distributed edge AI platform that runs across edge devices, cloud-isolated, and air-gapped environments. The work centers on architecting data synchronization frameworks built on CRDTs, content-addressable storage, and Merkle trees, along with peer-to-peer and decentralized networking concerns like distributed hash tables, gossip protocols, DAGs, overlay networks, and NAT traversal. Development is primarily in Rust, with related backend systems experience in C, C++, or Go, plus security-first design using cryptographic primitives and secure key management.
